question: The base of a right prism is a triangle with sides 16 cm, 30 cm and 34 cm. Its height is 32 cm. The lateral surface area (in cm²) and the volume (in cm³) are, respectively:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check for Pythagorean triplet: 16² + 30² = 256 + 900 = 1156 = 34². Base is a right triangle.

Perimeter of base = 16 + 30 + 34 = 80 cm.

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter × Height = 80 × 32 = 2560 cm².

Base Area = 1/2 × 16 × 30 = 240 cm².

Volume = Base Area × Height = 240 × 32 = 7680 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 2560 cm² and 7680 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of triangular base (a, b, c) = 16 cm, 30 cm, 34 cm.

Height of prism (h) = 32 cm.

**Formula Used:**

1. Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = Perimeter of base × height

2. Volume = Area of base × height

3. Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height (if right-angled)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b51323cb2cbbc6704a1268f9617b67e5469a4825338a02da6d1d57e3d6e616eb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Identification of Base: 16² + 30² = 256 + 900 = 1156 = 34². The base is a right-angled triangle.

⇒ Base Area = 1/2 × 16 × 30 = 8 × 30 = 240 cm².

⇒ Base Perimeter = 16 + 30 + 34 = 80 cm.

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter × Height = 80 × 32 = 2560 cm².

⇒ Volume = Base Area × Height = 240 × 32 = 7680 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 2560 cm² and 7680 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Prism

Total Surface Area (TSA) = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Area of Base. In this case, TSA = 2560 + 2(240) = 3040 cm².

Right Angled Triangles

A triangle is right-angled if the sum of the squares of the two shorter sides equals the square of the longest side (Pythagoras Theorem: a² + b² = c²).

General Prism Formula

A right prism is a 3D solid with two identical parallel bases and vertical rectangular sides. Volume is always Base Area × perpendicular height.</p
